crew.overview: Twelve episodic tales in the life of a Parisian woman and her slow descent into prostitution.
crew.title: Vivre Sa Vie

details.biography:
Marcel Sacotte was a French magistrate who wrote  Où en est la Prostitution, a study of contemporary prostitution and one of the original source materials used in Vivre sa Vie, a 1962 French New Wave drama film written and directed by Jean-Luc Godard.

From Wikipedia.
